children: Welcomhotel by ITC Hotels, Dwarka has launched Del One, a premium all-day dining restaurant that brings together Delhi’s food culture with flavours from across the world. Located within the hotel’s sunlit atrium, the restaurant combines food, contemporary architecture and views of the hotel’s soaring interiors.

Designed as an all-day dining destination, Del One features palm-lined spaces, warm wood accents, curved architectural forms, glass balustrades and a monochrome floor. The setting is designed to transition from daytime dining to evening meals and bar experiences.

The menu is structured around five culinary themes — the Good Mess; Dilli, the Roads That Led Here; West of Here; East of Here; and Mithai Meets the World. It combines familiar flavours and regional techniques with global influences, with dishes including Agra ki Aloo Tikki, Del One Gol Gappa, Purani Dilli Samosa, Darya Ganj Chicken-Tikka, Jama Masjid Seekh-Kebab, Neapolitan pizzas, pasta, noodles, bowls and curries.

Speaking on the launch, Nishant Negi, General Manager, Welcomhotel by ITC Hotels, Dwarka, said, “Del One is more than a restaurant; it is a destination where regional food, drinks and experiences come together. With an expansive setting, natural light and a menu that brings together tales and influences from around the world, we want every visit to feel familiar yet, new.”

He added, “Del One represents our vision of creating a vibrant culinary destination that connects the energy of Delhi with the growing dynamism of Dwarka. Through thoughtfully curated flavours, warm hospitality and memorable experiences, Del One aims to become a sought-after address that contributes meaningfully to the city’s evolving culinary narrative while putting Dwarka firmly on the gastronomic map.”
